title: Workstream B: Monte Carlo Random Abstention Baseline Audit

methodology.p_value_formula: p = (b + 1) / (B + 1), where b is count of random iterations with metric >= confidence metric
methodology.zero_p_value_policy: Strictly forbidden. Finite-sample lower bound is 1 / (B + 1).
methodology.coverage_100_special_case: At coverage 1.0, subset equals full dataset deterministically (variance 0.0, p-value 1.0).
